technical-summary: bc-serve --set keys engine.tp_wire, engine.no_prefix_cache and engine.gpu_headroom_mib write the amendment-11 production engine fields only when set (absent otherwise, so existing manifests are unchanged); optional-field support in the resolver; component test; operator guide for writing a manifest, starting with one and the key-to-field-to-flag table, with a migration status table (RSC11 A1).
user-summary-candidate: Serving manifests can now carry the tensor-parallel wire, prefix-cache and GPU headroom options, and there is an operator guide for writing and starting from a manifest.
